notes.title: Our New Game, ROBOCRACY, is Out Now!
notes.content:
We're excited to announce the release of our latest VR game, ROBOCRACY! If you're a fan of fast-paced space shooters, this one's for you. Take on the role of a Galactic Ranger and battle rogue AI forces across asteroid fields, alien planets, and massive space stations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35927966/2fb67104568aab281aef8683e1ee669201a0d897.gif[/img]
[previewyoutube=VsJJoHanu9c;full]
[/previewyoutube]



[h2]What to Expect:[/h2]

[list]
[*] 16 action-packed levels in 3 acts
[*] A variety of weapons, from bazookas to railguns
[*] Challenging missions that test your reflexes and strategies
[*] Whether you're new to VR or a seasoned player, ROBOCRACY offers an engaging experience filled with intense battles and immersive space environments.
[*] 
[/list]
Check it out on SteamVR: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1853510/ROBOCRACY/]ROBOCRACY steam page[/url]

notes.title: DGMA announce ROBOCRACY
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=ZGS87aQwyds;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Game description[/h2]
An Easy Learn game - the player flies through space and destroys the robots attacking him, defends himself from them with a shield and dodges obstacles, gradually moving along the plot of the game. Each game level is a part of the story in which the player is immersed along the way and turns out to be the center of these events, which gives him additional motivation to play. At the end of several levels of levels, the player is met by an opponent BOSS. Also in additional game modes, the player protects the earth's spaceship and participates in high-speed racing flights for accuracy. The player can play in these modes both alone and in a team with another player.

[h2]Game features[/h2]
[list]
[*]Co-op mode for two players will allow you to have fun with friends or parents with their children (co-op mode will require 2 vr devices), players connected to the network can be anywhere and they do not need a lot of space, 1.5x1.5m2 is enough.
[*]3 game acts with 5 levels each with an original design - which in total will make the passage of the main storyline at least 2 hours of the game session. This is a very large indicator for such a rich VR game and the user will return to the game at least 2 times.
[*]There are 10 types of weapons available in the game, and each type can be held separately in each hand and in this way lethal combinations are obtained against opponents, making the gameplay exciting and special. Each playthrough can be completely different.
[*]12 types of enemies of 3 different types and with 2 types of attacks each, which attack the player in different ways and appear randomly, which greatly increases the variability of the gameplay.
[*]3 main bosses and 3 secondary bosses, each with its own unique concept and surroundings.
[*]The player has two types of shield from possible damage, in different game situations the player will be forced to use different types of shield, which will add interest and involve in the passage, it will even be possible (if the player learns to use the shield well) to complete the game without using weapons at all.
[*]The game will implement the mechanics of dodging its platform (a small drone on which the player flies in space and on the surface of planets), which makes it possible for the player to turn the game into an obstacle race, which multiplies the variety of the gameplay.
[*]The story-tale of the game will not let you get bored and will be completely inside the gameplay, thereby making the player the epicenter of events.
[*]3 game difficulty modes will make the game comfortable for both beginners and experienced players.
[*]Player leaderboards will give you the chance to have your name inscribed in the Hall of Fame!
[/list]

[h2]Device support[/h2]
[b]AIO VR devices:[/b] Oculus Quest 2, Pico Neo3 and other All-in-one 6DoF devices.
[b]PCVR Devices:[/b] ValveIndex, VivePro, WMR devices and other PCVR Devices that support SteamVR.

Join us: [url=https://twitter.com/dgma_team]twitter[/url] and [url=https://discord.gg/a2bzYgH8nn]discord[/url]

notes.title: Christmas Update
notes.content:
It took us a lot of time to fight all of the terrible space bugs which destroyed the multiplayer mode for some users on the last update. So, now you can play with your friends again. 

Merry Christmas and happy New Year!

notes.title: Game Update to version 1.2.1
notes.content:
[h3]Space conquerors! We are glad to present you a new version of our game! We added and updated a lot of things there:[/h3]
[olist]
[*] A few critical and huge amount of minor bugs fixed
[*] Cooperation mode significantly improved
[*] Added smooth transitions during main menu loading and level restarting
[*] Added multiple notifications about player and game states
[*] Lagging problems during oculus pause solved
[*] Disconnect function added for coop game
[*] Observer mode added for coop game
[*] Local Multiplayer implemented
[*] Network significantly optimized
[*] Animations and IK improvements added
[*] Graphics quality settings improved
[*] The game significantly optimized and stable FPS achieved
[*] Player calibration implemented
[*] Materials and VFXs optimized
[*] VFXs improved
[*] Multiple defects in 3d models fixed
[*] Lightings optimized
[*] Particles optimized
[*] Game levels rebalanced 
[*] New content added
[*] Characters rigs improved
[*] Boss spaceship visuals improved
[/olist]
[h3]We hope you enjoy the updated adventure![/h3]

notes.title: Update v1.1 - Coop-mode
notes.content:
Rangers, attention!
Big changes happened!

Game update v1.1 is now live!

[b]Episode 01[/b]
[list]
[*] 4 upgraded weapon versions has been added to the game. Each have limited time and additional powers like projectile homing or increased fire rate. Check them out!
[*] Difficulties rebalance.
[*] Each difficulty now have 4 challenges with ahievements. Unlocking them give you different modifiers at Defence Mode.
[/list]

[b]Defence mode[/b]
[list]
[*] Now have 30 waves in total. 20 available instantly, extra 10 you can unlock after completing Episode 01 at all difficulties.
[*] Global online leaderboard. Compete with others to proove who's the best ranger!
[*] 8 different game modifiers affecting your playstyle. Affecting you final score.
[/list]

[b]General changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Non-VR playable game
[*] Keyboard+mouse support
[*] Gamepad support
[*] Online coop mode both for episode and defence modes
[*] Better optimisation
[*] Game settings with steam cloud support
[*] More soundtracks
[*] Reworked localization system (more supported languages in upcoming updates)
[/list]
